narrative: A [[visitor]] reads the [[site]]: the landing page, the blog and the docs.
A [[writer]] signs in through [[accounts|sign-in]], with GitHub or a link sent by [[svc-email|email]].
In the [[dashboard]] they write posts, which are saved to the database.
Free writers get a few posts; [[billing]] sends them to [[svc-stripe]] to upgrade.
[[stripe-events|Stripe]] reports back when they pay, and the plan is unlocked.

tours.title: Upgrading to Pro
captions: The billing page shows your plan and a button to upgrade or manage it.
Pressing it calls the app's Stripe route on the server.
The route checks your plan and opens a Stripe checkout for free users, or the billing portal for Pro users.
The Stripe client sends that request to Stripe, which returns the page to send you to.

tours.title: Stripe confirms a payment
captions: Stripe calls the webhook when a checkout completes or a subscription renews; the route checks the signature and reads the subscription.
It saves the Stripe customer, plan and period end on the user, which unlocks Pro.

tours.title: Creating a post
captions: The dashboard lists your posts with a New post button on top.
The button posts to the posts API, then opens the editor on the new post.
The posts route checks your plan before it creates anything.
The plan comes from your user row: free users are capped at three posts.

tours.title: Signing in by email
captions: Every sign-in request lands on NextAuth's route, which loads the app's auth settings.
For email sign-in, the auth settings send a one-time login link through the email provider.
